description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우체국 운송용 차량대수 현황 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 연도별(2012년~2024년) 우정사업본부의 우편물 운송차량데이터로 차량과 이륜차의 대수 항목을 제공합니다. 우정사업본부의 2012년부터 2019년까지의 우체국 운송용 차량 보유 현황 데이터로 전체적인 차량 대수는 증가하는 추세를 보입니다. 자동차는 2012년 3,847대에서 2019년 5,503대로 매... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 우정사업본부, 우체국, 운송용 차량, 자동차, 자동이륜차. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
